intent: Periodic higher-level syntheses written BACK into the graph as retrievable nodes. A consolidation is a DEPOSIT — born hypothesis, earns standing like everything else through the tenure loop. The consolidation fires on an event (a resolution boundary, a session close, a promotion cluster), never a clock. The synthesized node links to the source nodes it was derived from, and its provenance records the derivation method.
why: The biggest measured lever in the field: Generative Agents ablation d=8.16, the largest clean effect in the corpus (arXiv 2304.03442). A-Mem Zettelkasten-style linking (new notes link to AND UPDATE old ones): multi-hop F1 9.09->39.41, 6-7x token cut (arXiv 2502.12110). BUT: MemBench showed reflection-heavy architectures DEGRADE under prolonged interaction while plain retrieval holds (arXiv 2506.21605). The degradation happens because ungated consolidation rots — the tenure loop is the gate. A consolidation that must earn standing like any other node cannot rot the graph because the same decay/invalidation physics apply to it. The lived symptom: the librarian has 70 nodes that are all low-level fragments; nobody synthesizes them into the higher-level understanding that would resolve a broader question in one walk.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a consolidation node enters at standing 'earned' instead of 'hypothesis'; (2) consolidation fires on a timer/daemon instead of an event; (3) the synthesized node does not link to its source nodes (derivation is untraceable); (4) a consolidation of consolidated nodes (recursive reflection) is not gated by the same tenure physics — ungated recursion is the rot path; (5) consolidation runs when the source nodes are all from the same crossing (this is a summary, not a consolidation — crossing honesty applies).
design_notes: The tenure loop is the gate that prevents the MemBench degradation. A consolidation is the same kind of thing as a backfill mint — inference supplies a node — with a different provenance type ('consolidated' vs 'backfill'). The event that triggers it: TBD, but candidates are (a) promotion of a node (a cluster of related nodes just became trustworthy — synthesize them), (b) session close (the conversation's deposits are worth a summary), (c) a threshold count of related hypothesis-standing nodes (enough fragments to be worth compressing). The consolidation uses inference to produce the synthesis, so it costs a call — but the return is that the NEXT question resolves in one walk instead of many fragment matches.
borrow_cite: Generative Agents reflection (arXiv 2304.03442, d=8.16). A-Mem Zettelkasten linking (arXiv 2502.12110, multi-hop F1 4x). MemBench degradation warning (arXiv 2506.21605) — the counter-evidence that makes tenure-gating mandatory, not optional. Mechanism re-authored; the CONCEPT of reflective synthesis and the EVIDENCE for gating it are borrowed.
out_of_bounds: Warm set and time-aware retrieval (ticket #4). Proactive notification and contradiction (tickets #1, #2 — those land first). Any consolidation that runs outside the tenure loop's physics.
